name: ByteStash
description: Store, organize and share your code snippets

paths.name: Snippets
paths.description: ByteStash's database with your snippets and users, plus its sign-in secret. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: ByteStash web app, API (/api) and MCP endpoint (/mcp), published on host as 7004

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: ALLOW_NEW_ACCOUNTS
variables.description: true lets anyone who can open ByteStash make an account. Make yours first, then set false.

variables.name: TOKEN_EXPIRY
variables.description: How long a sign-in lasts, like 24h, 7d or 30d.
